subject: maths
question: Shan has ₹1617 with him. He divided it amongst his sons Piyush and Manoj and asked them to invest it at 10% rate of interest compounded annually. It was seen that Piyush and Manoj got same amount after 11 and 12 years respectively. How much (in ₹) did Shan give to Piyush?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

When amounts are equal, Ratio of Principal = Inverse ratio of multiplying factors.

Piyush's Share : Manoj's Share = (1 + 10/100)¹² − ¹¹ : 1

Ratio = 1.1 : 1 = 11 : 10

Piyush's share = 11 / (11 + 10) × 1617 = 11/21 × 1617

Piyush's share = 11 × 77 = ₹847

**∴ The correct answer is ₹847.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Total amount = ₹1617

Rate of interest (R) = 10% compounded annually

Time for Piyush (T₁) = 11 years

Time for Manoj (T₂) = 12 years

**Formula Used:**

Amount = P(1 + R/100)T
